    Every escaped fire's start, and whether it is in the core

    escapeStartsByDataYear.Rd

    fireSenseUtils::escapeFireSet() for each data-year group, with the starts the spread fit was given (harmonizeFireData()), so a fire is fitted from the start it is counted at.

    escapeStartsByDataYear(
  polys,
  points,
  flammableRTMs,
  allYears,
  coreRaster,
  definition,
  idCol
)

    Arguments

    polys, points

    lists named year<year> of the harmonized fire polygons and their start points. With points = NULL the starts are the polygons' centroids moved to the nearest burnable pixel (idCol is not needed).

    flammableRTMs

    list of SpatRasters named year<dataYear>.

    allYears

    list named by data year of the fire year names, as mod$allYears.

    coreRaster

    rasterToMatchLargeELF, or NULL when the run has no ELF (every fire is core).

    definition

    from fireSenseUtils::escapeDefinitionOf().

    idCol

    the fire ID column of polys and points.

    Value

    a SpatVector of start points, with core (see fireSenseUtils::fireStarts()), or NULL with no fires.
